entities.name: Skaro
entities.description: Non-canon plane, homeworld of the Thals and the Kaleds, later remade by the Daleks as the center of their empire.

entities.name: Thals
entities.description: One of the two humanoid races of Skaro.

entities.name: Kaleds
entities.description: One of the two humanoid races of Skaro.

entities.name: Davros
entities.description: Kaled scientist who created the Dalek race.

entities.name: Daleks
entities.description: Race created by Davros that remade Skaro into the center of the Dalek Empire.

entities.name: Thousand Year War
entities.description: War between the Thals and the Kaleds that devastated and irradiated Skaro.

entities.name: Dalek Empire
entities.description: Empire of the Daleks centered on Skaro.

events.summary: The Thousand Year War led the Kaled scientist Davros to create the Daleks.
events.quote: The two races had a Thousand Year War which led to the Kaled scientist Davros creating the Dalek race.

events.summary: The Daleks remade Skaro as the center of the Dalek Empire.
events.quote: Skaro was remade by the Daleks and became the center of the Dalek Empire
